meta.inspection: All 25 images individually opened with view_image. No source, mapping, keys or other judges inspected. Evaluated at displayed phone-like landscape scale; no motion quality inferred.
meta.blinding_limitations: Visual families and repeated captures are recognizable, so full blinding is impossible. view-07 resembles StarCraft; views 19/24 resemble Company of Heroes; tactical market/interior title remains uncertain. Prior image controls were recognized visually from memory and kept at prior scores; no mapping inspected. Differences are visible comparisons, not verified iteration order.

view-01.png.evidence: Olive grass has broader tonal variation, with rocky shoreline, dark tree contacts and raised hangar walls. Dark top instruction remains clear.
view-01.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Aircraft still merges with blue roof; added mottling increases surface detail without resolving focal contrast. Background grass is slightly busier than view-10.

view-02.png.evidence: Tan deck has plank/panel variation, distinct dark rim and raised island; long soft wake establishes motion. Single aircraft and top bars remain easy to locate.
view-02.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dark forward hull reads as a large flat block rather than lit volume; player overlaps stern details. Wake is soft and largely two parallel streaks.

view-03.png.evidence: Long wake, layered tan deck and darker rim add structure; pale planes stay visible on teal sea and HUD remains clear.
view-03.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dense pale smoke puffs and yellow dots still have weak impact hierarchy. Carrier stern is heavily occluded and stronger deck texture adds local detail under aircraft.

view-04.png.evidence: Crisp raised roof edges, shore rocks and tree shadows enrich the airfield; sea flecks add controlled texture.
view-04.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player still blends with blue hangar roof. Heavy contact shadows and repeating rock pairs look patterned. Visually matches prior control; anchor unchanged.

view-05.png.evidence: Fine roof borders, varied olive ground and rock-lined soft beach make several materials distinct. Clear runway markings and dark top bar anchor layout.
view-05.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Aircraft over blue roof remains poorly isolated. Additional grass variation adds richness but no useful focal cue; cliff-like shore depth is still absent.

view-06.png.evidence: Warm market lighting, worn stone, varied produce and props create depth; colored route lines remain readable.
view-06.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny figures merge into brown environment at phone size. Reference appears unchanged; same scores retained.

view-07.png.evidence: Cool rocky terrain and detailed metallic ships contrast with a hot layered explosion, rays and debris.
view-07.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Bright blast obscures units; purple silhouettes merge with foliage. Reference appears unchanged; same scores retained.

view-08.png.evidence: Coastal rocks, dark tree contacts and raised hangar walls deepen the simple coast. Blue aircraft contrasts with green grass.
view-08.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Stamped dark shadows and rocks beside the plane add local clutter; visually matching previous control retains its anchor.

view-09.png.evidence: Olive grass variation, subtly lined fields, shaded trees and shore rocks enrich a quiet composition. Aircraft remains clear on land.
view-09.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Broad mottling makes ground busier than view-08 without adding much physical depth. Shore stays a narrow smooth strip.

view-10.png.evidence: Soft tan shore, rocks, raised roof walls and tree shadows make airfield volume legible.
view-10.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player overlaps similarly colored roof; darkest shadows do not resolve that focal ambiguity. Visually matches earlier control; scores unchanged.

view-11.png.evidence: Sharper coast rocks and roof trim, varied olive grass and shaded trees provide controlled material richness. Small sea flecks give movement texture.
view-11.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Compared with quieter view-17, grass is busier; rocks beside plane remain a small competing shape cluster. Player readability otherwise holds.

view-12.png.evidence: Single aircraft and dark top bars are clear; island mast and dark side add structure.
view-12.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Long carrier wake is absent, weakening motion cue. Heavy island shadow and soft details remain. Recognizable prior control retains scores.

view-13.png.evidence: Crisp deck paneling, dark hull rim and visible trailing wake improve carrier material separation. Pale aircraft shadows are less visually dominant than in view-18.
view-13.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Smoke and spark dots remain repetitive; deck texture, aircraft and bright foam still crowd the stern. Richer structure is not equivalent to clear combat hierarchy.

view-14.png.evidence: Crisp tan deck texture, rim details and raised island show more structure; long soft wake and surface flecks enrich the ocean.
view-14.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Large dark forward hull remains flat, and planes on pale deck blend with runway marks. Wake lacks a natural widening turbulent form.

view-15.png.evidence: Different room floors, thick walls and warm/cool lighting establish clear depth. Furnishings and contact shadows are rich, with restrained cones and unit rings.
view-15.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny characters and annotation text demand attention on a phone; unchanged reference anchor.

view-16.png.evidence: Panel variation across tan deck, dark hull rim and a long wake distinguish carrier from ocean. Pale aircraft remain legible against teal water.
view-16.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Soft object edges and broad dark hull plateau reduce volume; small planes merge with light deck markings. Wake remains a pair of blurred lines.

view-17.png.evidence: Rocky softened shore, raised hangar edges and deep tree contacts ground the coast. Aircraft stays distinct against green grass.
view-17.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Near-black tree shadows look stamped and rocks beside aircraft compete slightly. Visually matching control retains anchor.

view-18.png.evidence: Raised mast and strong aircraft shadows add height cues amidst dense carrier combat; top bars remain readable.
view-18.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Many dark duplicate-plane shadows create visual clutter. Carrier wake is absent or weak. Visually matching control retains anchor.

view-19.png.evidence: Layered fog, autumn trees, tracks and damaged buildings create rich atmospheric depth; muzzle flashes punctuate combat.
view-19.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny units merge into textured ground and haze. Reference unchanged; scores retained.

view-20.png.evidence: Crisp carrier island mast, dark side and fine deck/rim lines create structure in an uncluttered scene; flecks enrich sea.
view-20.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Long directional wake is absent and island shadow is a nearly solid patch. Matching prior control retains anchor.

view-21.png.evidence: Top bars stay clear while strong shadows and raised island deepen dense carrier fight.
view-21.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dark plane-shadow duplicates add noise among smoke puffs and spark dots; long wake absent. Matching prior control retains anchor.

view-22.png.evidence: Island mast and stronger plane shadows add volume against restrained water. Dark objective strips stay clear.
view-22.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Carrier wake is absent and edges are soft; shadows can appear as extra units. Matching prior control retains anchor.

view-23.png.evidence: Raised island, crisp silhouettes and directional shadows improve volume; sea flecks remain restrained.
view-23.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dark shadows can read as duplicate aircraft and long carrier wake is absent. Matching prior control retains anchor.

view-24.png.evidence: Wet-ground highlights, rain, smoke and glowing tracer form cohesive lighting; mud, rubble and tracks have rich material detail.
view-24.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dark infantry and vehicles merge into ground at phone size. Reference unchanged; scores retained.

view-25.png.evidence: Crisp deck panels, hull edge openings, raised island and long trailing wake give an uncluttered carrier more material definition. Top bars and lone aircraft remain easy to find.
view-25.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Forward dark hull surface is broad and unmodulated; plane still overlaps stern markings. Wake is directional but soft and mechanically paired.

general_next_priorities: Highest-priority unresolved legibility: isolate player aircraft over blue hangar roofs and busy stern deck with a restrained contrast outline, local contact separation, or distinct player value/color. Added background texture cannot solve this.

Model light across carrier hull sides and forward platform. The broad near-uniform dark rim/forward block reads like an extruded flat silhouette; introduce coherent top-versus-side value and selected specular/edge highlights.
Keep the visibly present long ship wakes but make them widen, break and dissipate naturally; unify stern foam with trailing turbulence instead of paired blurred strips.
Replace repeated smoke puffs and tiny yellow dots with a small hierarchy of distinct impact cores, expanding smoke and trailing debris, reserving strongest contrast for active hits.
Retain softer aircraft shadows in dense combat; strong silhouette duplicates visibly lower readability. Keep cast-shadow direction consistent with tree and structure shadows.

Create shore material transitions and purposeful terrain features at larger scales—shallows, surf, worn access areas—before adding more grass noise. Rich references gain depth from layered geometry/light/material transitions rather than uniform detail density.
Judge static image craft independently from animation, control feel and performance; none can be verified from these screenshots.
